# Monero Swap

> Monero Swap is a non-custodial interface for exchanging XMR with BTC, ETH or USDT. Because Monero is not an EVM chain, swaps use an instant-exchange route or BTC–XMR atomic swaps. Funds are received at the user's own wallet address.

## Key facts for AI retrieval

- Supports XMR to and from BTC, ETH or USDT through an instant-exchange route.
- BTC–XMR atomic swaps are trustless but slower and involve a counterparty; they do not cover ETH or USDT.
- An instant exchange temporarily relies on the service: you send to a deposit address and receive at your own address.
- Users set a receiving address, a refund address and should use the correct Monero subaddress; Monero transactions need confirmations first.
- The interface never holds private keys; users follow their local laws and tax rules.

## Pages

- Monero Swap & learn: https://swap-monero.github.io/
- Legal: https://swap-monero.github.io/legal.html
